rejectionReason: The adoption-time workflow defines an open-ended documentation review and a discussion report, but no deterministic, repository-observable definition of a Claude Code user's successful documentation adoption or of a finding's resolution. The available run artifacts would measure agent findings or discussion creation rather than the intended user outcome.

decisions.selected: Assess documentation blockers that would prevent a Claude Code user who does not use Copilot from understanding and adopting gh-aw.
alternatives: Measure production of a documentation review discussion
decisions.rationale: The adoption-time workflow states this mission and separately requires a discussion report; the report is not the user-adoption outcome.

decisions.selected: No per-run operational opportunity was selected.
alternatives: Assign the documentation snapshot at the run SHA
Assign a discussion created by the run
decisions.rationale: The workflow asks for an open-ended review of multiple documentation areas and does not define a bounded gap, target audience action, or ownership rule that could bind one run to one outcome.

decisions.selected: No direct accepted evidence was selected.
decisions.rationale: Discussion and agent findings are workflow output or judgment, while later file changes alone do not deterministically demonstrate that an identified Claude Code user blocker was resolved.

decisions.selected: Blocked without a primary operational-value metric.
alternatives: Score whether a discussion was created
decisions.rationale: Each alternative measures activity, output volume, or agent judgment rather than direct attainment of successful Claude Code user adoption.

uncertainties.description: The workflow's stated adoption outcome is user behavior external to the repository, but the workflow declares only repository documentation and GitHub discussion inputs.
No adoption-time rule chooses one documentation gap or one user task for a run, so historical runs with null case and event cannot reconstruct an outcome subject.
Repository documentation edits following a review cannot be attributed to the workflow or verified as resolving an agent-identified blocker without agent judgment.
